g.title: video_processor_dataflow
g.text: signal names from image_processing/video_processor/src/video_processor.sv; clocks / resets (not drawn): arst_n, byte_clk, cpu_clk, lvds_ser_clk, pix_clk, tmds_ser_clk, tx_byte_clk
clock / reset only (not drawn): reset_sync u_rst_cpu, reset_sync u_rst_pix, reset_sync u_rst_byte, reset_sync u_rst_tx_byte, reset_sync u_rst_tmds, reset_sync u_rst_lvds
thick teal line = protocol bus (AXI4-Stream / AXI4 / AXI4-Lite, ready and responses implied); a bus signal also used elsewhere is drawn separately
